reading: A reading, joined on role: Zid's Export requests (طلبات التصدير) is a page of its own under Settings (ZD-S-0803; ZD-I-0132, General › طلبات التصدير, new dashboard), where 'عند طلب أي ملف مُصدّر، ستتمكن من تحميله مباشرة في متصفحك' (ZD-S-0804): the store's requested exports, apart from where an export is started. Salla's Export log (سجل التصدير) is likewise a page of its own for the store's exports (SA-S-1890, /logs/export) with its own permission (SA-S-2423). Strained: Salla doesn't say what its export log records, and Zid's page is a list of requests whose files are downloaded there, so the two may not be the same object; and the concern's boundary statement, the Merchant API Product Export (ZD-C-044/boundary/ZD-S-0018), is cited in CM-MIG-001, another tree (CM-MIG-004 has no parent). The reviewer may move the concern to CM-MIG-001.
